title: Fluency (Theme 1: Activities at home and school)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child points under each word, reads every letter left to right, and sounds out a hard word instead of guessing.
steps: Read the text to the child first.
contexts: a story about duties at home
a notice about safety on the road

board.do: Write: Wanjiru sweeps the house before school.

board.say: Read with me, then on your own.

board.do: The child underlines the word he or she found hard.

listen_for: The cow is in the horse.
misconceptions.ask: Look at all the letters: does it say horse?
Which way does the belly face?
misconceptions.repair: Make the bed with your fists.

misconceptions.ask: Did your finger touch every word?

listen_for: Wanjiru. Sweeps. The. Classroom. Every. Morning.
misconceptions.ask: Can you scoop the words together?
misconceptions.repair: Wanjiru sweeps the classroom / every morning.

checks.question: Read: Brian brought a black brush.
checks.answer: all words right, bl and br read

checks.question: Read: The bird sat on the bed.
checks.answer: bird and bed with b, not d
